title: Japanese-Style Stuffed Burrata
description: A creative take on traditional ingredients, blending Japanese flavors with creamy burrata. This dish is a delightful fusion of earthy notes and rich textures.

ingredients.name: Burrata cheese
ingredients.notes: Choose a high-quality burrata for the best results

ingredients.name: Lovely mushrooms (shiitake)
ingredients.notes: Sliced into thin strips for easy cooking

ingredients.name: Earthy sesame oil
ingredients.notes: Add a nutty flavor to the dish

ingredients.name: Greek honey
ingredients.notes: A touch of sweetness to balance the earthy flavors

instructions: 2. Slice the stifado onions into thin rings and separate them into individual rings.
3. In a small bowl, mix together earthy sesame oil and Greek honey.
4. Brush the mixture onto the stifado onion rings and separate them onto a baking sheet.
5. Bake for 15-20 minutes, or until caramelized and golden brown.
6. Meanwhile, slice the lovely mushrooms into thin strips and sauté them in a pan until tender.
7. Once the onions are done, set them aside and add the sautéed mushrooms to the pan.
8. Crumbling the burrata cheese into the pan, mix well with the mushroom mixture.
9. Season with a pinch of salt and pepper to taste.
10. Serve warm, garnished with additional stifado onions if desired.
